title: Endpoint-level tail latency baselining and alerting workflow
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a rigorous baselining and alerting workflow for endpoint-level tail latency (p95/p99) sliced by route, model, and region. This ticket covers metric definitions, storage and rollup strategies, dashboard surfaces, alerting rules (both absolute and relative/regression), and synthetic load harness runs to validate thresholds. The goal is to provide stable historical baselines and automated regression detection so on-call and SRE teams can quickly triage regressions that affect customer SLAs and observed tokens/sec throughput.
acceptance_criteria: Per-endpoint (route+model+region) p95 and p99 time series emitted to metrics pipeline with 1m granularity
Daily baseline computed (7d rolling median + seasonality adjustment) and stored for fast comparison
Dashboards: heatmap view + time-series with baseline overlay and per-percentile breakdown exposed in Console
Alerting rules: (1) absolute SLO breach, (2) relative regression >15% vs baseline for 30m window, with noise guard to avoid flapping
Synthetic load harness script to reproduce high tokens/sec scenarios and validate alert firing in staging
Runbook created and linked in incident playbook; documented triage steps and rollback triggers
work_items: Define metric name and tag schema (route, model, region, endpoint_id, shard)
Add p95/p99 aggregation to percentile-emitter job and ensure consistent buckets across models
Implement 7-day rolling baseline job with seasonal decomposition and anomaly scoring
Create Console dashboard panels: percentile heatmap, endpoint detail page, model comparison table
Author alerting DSL rules and deploy to staging with alert routing to #sre-latency-alerts and paging policy
Extend load harness to run multi-region tokens/sec ramps and record telemetry to synthetic namespace
Run staging validation, capture screenshots, and iterate on thresholds with PM/Design feedback
observed_metrics_example: baseline_example: 7d rolling median p95 for route=/v1/generate@us-west-2=185ms, current 210ms => relative delta +13%

risks_and_mitigation: High-cardinality tags (model+route+region) may increase metrics storage costs: mitigate by rollup/aggregation retention policy and sample-based percentile estimation for low-volume endpoints
False positives due to traffic seasonality: use seasonality-adjusted baselines and a noise guard requiring sustained delta over 30m
Backend overhead from synthetic harness on shared staging infra: run during off-hours and throttle agent concurrency
